```md
## Arsitektur "Write-Clean, Deploy-Locked"

Pemisahan kode sumber bersih untuk pengembangan AI otonom dari biner produksi yang terkunci dan siap akuisisi.

### Tahap 1: Iterasi & Penulisan Bersih

Bot AI membaca dan menulis kode murni yang rapi ke Shadow Vault (Private Git) agar AI tidak kehilangan konteks pada update berikutnya.

INSPEKSI KOMPONEN & IZIN AKSES (FINE-GRAINED PAT) Terpilih: 1. Bot AI Otonom

### 1. Bot AI Otonom (Orchestrator)

Menulis fitur baru, membaca konteks kode bersih secara utuh, dan mengatur otomatisasi rilis tanpa terganggu kode yang sudah diacak.

Artefak & Konteks Memori AST Konteks Penuh, Rencana Eksekusi Agent, & Diff Patch Murni

agent_orchestrator.py

Izin Fine-Grained PAT & Token Akses Baca/Tulis ke Shadow Vault & Token Penulis Turso DB

Contents: Read & Write (Shadow)

### 2. Shadow Vault (Private Git)

Menyimpan 100% Clean Source Code, komentar rapi, dan dokumentasi lengkap sebagai sumber kebenaran tunggal (Single Source of Truth).

File & Data Tersimpan Kode Sumber Python/TS Asli, Dokumentasi Arsitektur, & Unit Test

src/core/*.py, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

Izin Fine-Grained PAT Repositori Privat Terisolasi — Hanya diakses Bot AI & CI Trigger

Actions: Write | Contents: Read/Write

### 3. Turso Database (libSQL Vault)

Menyimpan System Prompts asli, kunci dekripsi tensor (K), dan log sinkronisasi versi di luar repositori Git.

Skema Tabel & Rahasia Tabel System Prompts, Kunci AES-GCM (K), & Riwayat Versi Rilis

system_prompts, encryption_keys

Izin Akses & Keamanan Token JWT libSQL Terbatas (Read-Only saat Runtime Produksi)

TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN (Scoped RW/RO)

### 4. Pipeline Pengunci (Compiler)

Mengubah kode bersih menjadi biner terkompilasi (.so / O-LLVM) dan mengunci bobot tensor secara otomatis sebelum rilis.

Proses Transformasi Build Cython/Nuitka + O-LLVM Control Flow Flattening & Enkripsi Tensor

build_locked.sh → core_engine.so

Izin Fine-Grained PAT Baca dari Shadow Vault, Tulis Biner ke Repo Publik

Shadow: Read | Public Repo: Write

### 5. Repo Publik / Produksi

Berisi kode biner terkunci yang aman dari pencurian atau rekayasa balik (tanpa kode sumber asli maupun prompt rahasia).

Artefak Produksi Publik File Shared Object (.so), Bobot Terenkripsi (.enc), & Wrapper Tipis

dist/core_engine.so, weights.enc

Izin Fine-Grained PAT Hanya menerima Push otomatis dari Pipeline CI/CD Pengunci

Contents: Write (CI Bot Only)

### 6. Paket Akuisisi (Pembeli)

Menerima akses bersih dari Shadow Vault + Export Database Turso saat transaksi jual-beli proyek (Exit/Acquisition).

Isi Paket Serah Terima 100% Clean Git History + Dump SQL Turso (Prompt & Kunci Dekripsi)

shadow_repo.bundle + turso_dump.sql

Protokol Transfer Hak Milik Transfer Kepemilikan Repo Privat & Rotasi Token Master Turso

Repo Transfer + Master DB Handover
```

PRODUKSI 2026 READY Zero-Cost Launch Architecture

### Peta Jalan Eksekusi Peluncuran: Dari Kredensial Inti hingga Otomasi Evolusi Mandiri

Kesiapan Peluncuran 0% 0 dari 18 tugas

Biaya Modal Hari-1 Rp 0 100% Free Tiers / Tanpa CC

Target Margin Bersih 95% Langfuse Margin Guard

Beban Server Viral Anti-Tumbang RouteLLM + Serverless

#### Distribusi Waktu Eksekusi & Bobot Arsitektur

Estimasi durasi implementasi dan kuota tugas per fase peluncuran

H-1/H-2 (Jam) Tugas Kunci

FASE 1 : URGENT H-1 s/d Jam ke-2

Modal: Rp 0 (Nir-Kartu)

##### Akuisisi Identitas, Gateway & Kolam Kuota API Gratis

Mendaftarkan seluruh sumber daya yang 100% instan tanpa verifikasi kartu kredit. Dilakukan di hari pertama agar seluruh token pool aktif dan tidak tertahan saat bot mendadak viral.

Daftar Akun GitHub Baru & Personal Access Token (PAT): Fondasi repo kode, CI/CD Actions, dan integrasi webhook repositori. Buat 3 Bot Telegram via @BotFather: Dapatkan token untuk Master Router Bot, Admin Alert Bot, dan Payment Verification Bot. Koleksi 15+ API Key Model Gratis (Tier Nir-Kartu): Ambil key Google AI Studio (Gemini Flash), Groq Cloud, NVIDIA NIM, Mistral, OpenRouter Free, NgodeAI, Dahl/Gonka. Database Edge & Caching Serverless: Buat database di Turso (SQLite Edge - 9GB gratis) & Upstash (Serverless Redis - 10k request/hari gratis). Kasir Otomatis Pakasir v2 & CryptoBot: Ambil merchant slug & API token Pakasir untuk QRIS dinamis serta @CryptoBot untuk pembayaran stablecoin.

FASE 2 : MAIN (HARI PELUNCURAN) Jam ke-3 s/d Jam ke-8

Uptime: 99.9%

##### Perakitan Router Cerdas, Kasir QRIS v2 & Web Futuristic Luxury

Jantung platform yang menyatukan seluruh API free-tier menjadi satu API OpenAI-compatible berkecepatan tinggi, dihubungkan ke kasir QRIS otomatis dan web elegan berbasis Next.js 15.

Deploy OmniRoute / New-API Gateway: Pasang router di Render.com atau GitHub Codespaces untuk menyatukan 15+ API key ke satu endpoint. Integrasikan RouteLLM (Matrix Factorization): Pasang controller `router-mf-0.11593` untuk memotong prompt receh ke Llama-3-8B gratis dan simpan model kuat untuk prompt kompleks. Rakit Website Futuristic Luxury di Cloudflare Pages: Next.js 15 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Aceternity UI (Spotlight & Background Beams) + Magic UI (Border Beam) untuk tampilan bernilai jual tinggi. Sambungkan Webhook Kasir QRIS Pakasir v2: Validasi bayar detik per detik; saat saldo Rp 10.000 masuk, token bot langsung diterbitkan otomatis tanpa sentuhan manual. Pasang Langfuse Observability (Margin Guard): Lacak biaya per trace & per token, pastikan margin kotor tetap di atas 90-95% dari harga jual konsumen.

FASE 3 : SECONDARY / SCALING Minggu ke-1 Pasca-Launch

Redundansi Penuh

##### Penguncian VPS Permanen & Model Mandiri Uncensored

Memasukkan sumber daya yang membutuhkan verifikasi kartu debit/kredit tanpa terkena biaya sepeser pun, mengaktifkan mesin komputasi mandiri dan model lokal tanpa sensor.

Daftar Oracle Cloud Free Tier (4 ARM OCPU + 24GB RAM): Gunakan trik PAYG upgrade dan kunci ketat dengan Budget Alert \$0.01 agar instance tidak pernah dihapus paksa. Siapkan Modal Serverless GPU (\$30 Kredit): Sebagai katup pengaman saat ribuan pengguna login serentak dan kuota free tier habis. Pull Model Lokal Uncensored via Ollama / vLLM: Jalankan model seperti `Huihui-Qwen3.8B-abliterated` & `DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B` di VPS permanen. Hubungkan Grosir NanoGPT & PayPerQ: Sediakan backup grosir token murah tanpa langganan bulanan langsung dari profit penjualan QRIS.

FASE 4 : OPTIONAL / EVOLUTION Bulan ke-1 & Berkelanjutan

Otonom 100%

##### Otomasi Self-Evolving CI/CD & Subsidi Bandwidth DePIN

Membuat bot memodifikasi dan memperbarui kodenya sendiri secara otonom saat ada tool open-source baru yang lebih canggih, didanai penuh oleh komputasi pasif DePIN.

Deploy Hermes Agent (Nous Research) & OpenClaw: Aktifkan arsitektur cognitive file system ( `SOUL.md` , `SKILL.md` ) untuk belajar dari tiap kegagalan. Automated Testing E2B Sandbox + ModelScan: Setiap kode hasil update dari agen diuji di sandbox terisolasi sebelum dimasukkan ke branch produksi utama. Cron Harian Kurasi Top-100 GitHub Repos: Gunakan script smolagents untuk inspeksi repo trending (MIT/Apache 2.0) dan buat PR adaptasi otomatis tiap jam 02:00 pagi. Nyalakan Node Pasif DePIN (Grass & Nosana): Jalankan Grass desktop/docker di bandwidth idle untuk mendulang \$USDC dan mendanai domain & DNS secara otomatis.

Urutan prioritas pembangunan dan peluncuran sistem. Fase URGENT dan MAIN diselesaikan pada Hari ke-1 sepenuhnya tanpa kartu kredit untuk langsung membuka arus kas pelanggan, sementara Fase SECONDARY dan OPTIONAL berjalan paralel untuk mengunci kemandirian perangkat keras dan pendapatan pasif DePIN.

def run(cmd, check=True):
    if DRY:
        print(f"[DRY] {cmd}")
        return ""
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if check and r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return r.stdout.strip()

def write(path: Path, content: str):
    if path.exists():
        print(f"skip (exists): {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        return
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if DRY:
        print(f"[DRY] write {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    else:
        path.write_text(content)
        print(f"create: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")

def bootstrap():
    print(f"== Bootstrap started {datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}Z ==")
    for rel, desc in TREE.items():
        d = ROOT / rel
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        readme = d / "README.md"
        if not readme.exists():
            write(readme, PLACEHOLDER_README.format(name=rel, desc=desc))
        gitkeep = d / ".gitkeep"
        if not gitkeep.exists() and not any(d.iterdir()):
            gitkeep.touch()

    for rel, content in BRAIN_FILES.items():
        write(ROOT / rel, content)

    for rel, content in ROOT_FILES.items():
        write(ROOT / rel, content)

    if DRY:
        print("== DRY RUN selesai ==")
        return

    branch = f"chore/bootstrap-{datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d')}"
    run("git checkout -B " + branch, check=False)
    run("git add -A")
    run('git commit -m "chore: bootstrap repo structure (auto)"', check=False)
    print(f"== Bootstrap selesai. Branch: {branch} ==")
    print("Next: push & buka PR, atau jalankan: git push -u origin " + branch)
    print("Owner: review PR sebelum merge.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    bootstrap()

import os, requests
from bots_core.dispatcher import dispatch, verify

TOKEN = os.environ["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]
OWNER = int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID"])

def handle_update(u):
    msg = u.get("message")
    if not msg: return
    chat_id = msg["chat"]["id"]
    user_id = msg["from"]["id"]
    text = (msg.get("text") or "").strip()

    if user_id != OWNER:
        requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage",
                      json={"chat_id": chat_id, "text": "Unauthorized."})
        return

    if not verify(channel="telegram", user_id=user_id, text=text):
        requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage",
                      json={"chat_id": chat_id, "text": "Auth gagal."})
        return

    result = dispatch(text, channel="telegram", user_id=user_id)
    requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage",
                  json={"chat_id": chat_id, "text": result[:4000]})

name: keepalive
on:
  schedule: [{cron: "*/15 * * * *"}]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  ping:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Health check
        run: |
          curl -fsS ${{ secrets.HEALTHCHECK_URL }} || exit 1
      - name: Notify owner if down
        if: failure()
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}/sendMessage" \
            -d chat_id=${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID }} \
            -d text="⚠️ keepalive: health check GAGAL"

name: command-router
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  dispatch:
    if: contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'command')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: "3.11"}
      - run: pip install -r office/orchestrator/requirements.txt
      - name: Dispatch command
        env:
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          OWNER: ${{ github.actor }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          OWNER_PIN: ${{ secrets.OWNER_PIN }}
          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
        run: python bots/github/dispatch.py
      - name: Comment result
        if: always()
        run: gh issue comment $ISSUE_NUMBER --body "Command diproses. Cek log."

name: security
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Secret scan
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
      - name: SAST (Semgrep)
        run: pip install semgrep && semgrep ci
      - name: Dependency scan
        run: |
          npm audit --audit-level=high || true
          pip-audit || true
      - name: Container scan
        run: echo "trivy scan di sini"
      - name: Block merge if critical
        run: echo "CI gagal = merge diblokir"

name: nightly-audit
on:
  schedule: [{cron: "0 18 * * *"}]
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python office/orchestrator/nightly_audit.py
      - name: Push digest to owner
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}/sendMessage" \
            -d chat_id=${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID }} \
            -d text="📊 Nightly audit selesai. Cek dashboard."

Layer Pemilik Isi
Brain Owner office/brain/*.md — strategi, prinsip, aturan
Config Owner + agent office/config/*.yaml — agents, gates, kill switch
Orchestrator Agent (auto) office/orchestrator/*
Execution Agent (sandbox) apps/, bots/, services/
Control Plane Owner only kill switch, approval broker, notification
Audit Immutable office/logs/audit.log

# bots/core/__init__.py
__version__ = "0.1.0"

"""
Verifikasi perintah owner dari channel mana pun.
Aturan: owner match + PIN (untuk perintah sensitif) + HMAC + timestamp window.
"""
import os, hmac, hashlib, time
from typing import Literal

Channel = Literal["telegram", "whatsapp", "instagram", "threads", "github_issue"]

OWNER_PIN = os.environ.get("OWNER_PIN", "")
HMAC_SECRET = os.environ.get("HMAC_SECRET", "").encode()
WINDOW_SEC = int(os.environ.get("AUTH_WINDOW_SEC", "60"))

# Daftar perintah yang WAJIB PIN + HMAC
SENSITIVE_PREFIXES = (
    "/panic", "/freeze", "/approve", "/deny",
    "/recover", "/readonly", "/spawn", "/pr create",
)

OWNER_IDS: dict[Channel, set[str]] = {
    "telegram":     set(filter(None, os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID", "").split(","))),
    "whatsapp":     set(filter(None, os.environ.get("WHATSAPP_OWNER_NUMBER", "").split(","))),
    "instagram":    set(filter(None, os.environ.get("INSTAGRAM_OWNER_ID", "").split(","))),
    "threads":      set(filter(None, os.environ.get("THREADS_OWNER_ID", "").split(","))),
    "github_issue": set(filter(None, os.environ.get("GITHUB_OWNER_LOGIN", "").split(","))),
}

def is_sensitive(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.strip().lower()
    return any(t.startswith(p) for p in SENSITIVE_PREFIXES)

def is_owner(channel: Channel, user_id: str) -> bool:
    return str(user_id) in OWNER_IDS.get(channel, set())

def verify_pin(text: str) -> bool:
    """PIN ditulis di akhir perintah, contoh: /panic 123456"""
    if not OWNER_PIN:
        return False
    parts = text.strip().split()
    return len(parts) >= 2 and parts[-1] == OWNER_PIN

def verify_hmac(payload: str, signature: str, ts: int, nonce: str) -> bool:
    if not HMAC_SECRET:
        return False
    if abs(time.time() - ts) > WINDOW_SEC:
        return False
    msg = f"{payload}|{ts}|{nonce}".encode()
    expected = hmac.new(HMAC_SECRET, msg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature)

def verify(channel: Channel, user_id: str, text: str,
           signature: str | None = None, ts: int | None = None,
           nonce: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """
    Return: {"ok": bool, "reason": str, "clean_text": str}
    clean_text = text tanpa PIN di belakang.
    """
    if not is_owner(channel, user_id):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "owner_mismatch", "clean_text": text}

    if is_sensitive(text):
        if not verify_pin(text):
            return {"ok": False, "reason": "pin_invalid", "clean_text": text}
        if signature and ts and nonce:
            if not verify_hmac(text, signature, ts, nonce):
                return {"ok": False, "reason": "hmac_invalid", "clean_text": text}
        parts = text.strip().split()
        clean = " ".join(parts[:-1])
        return {"ok": True, "reason": "ok", "clean_text": clean}

    return {"ok": True, "reason": "ok", "clean_text": text.strip()}

"""
Dispatcher tunggal untuk semua channel.
Terima teks perintah → verifikasi → route ke orchestrator.
"""
import json, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from .verify import verify, Channel

AUDIT = Path("office/logs/audit.log")
AUDIT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def _audit(event: dict):
    event["ts"] = time.time()
    line = json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
    h = hashlib.sha256(line.encode()).hexdigest()
    with AUDIT.open("a") as f:
        f.write(f"{h} {line}\n")

def _route(clean_text: str, channel: Channel, user_id: str) -> str:
    """
    Routing tipis: panggil orchestrator lokal / HTTP.
    Gunakan import lokal agar mudah diuji.
    """
    try:
        from office.orchestrator.main import dispatch_command
        return dispatch_command(text=clean_text, channel=channel, user_id=str(user_id))
    except Exception as e:
        return f"⚠️ orchestrator error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"

def dispatch(text: str, channel: Channel, user_id: str,
             signature: str | None = None,
             ts: int | None = None,
             nonce: str | None = None) -> str:
    v = verify(channel=channel, user_id=str(user_id), text=text,
               signature=signature, ts=ts, nonce=nonce)
    _audit({"type": "command_in", "channel": channel,
            "user": str(user_id), "ok": v["ok"], "reason": v["reason"],
            "text_hash": hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()})

    if not v["ok"]:
        return f"⛔ Ditolak: {v['reason']}"

    result = _route(v["clean_text"], channel, user_id)
    _audit({"type": "command_out", "channel": channel,
            "result_preview": result[:200]})
    return result

"""
GitHub IssueOps: owner buka Issue berlabel 'command' berisi perintah.
Format body:
  /status
  /panic 123456
  /approve apv_2026_001 123456
Verifikasi: actor = owner + PIN (untuk perintah sensitif).
"""
import os, sys, subprocess, json
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from bots.core.dispatcher import dispatch

def comment_issue(issue: int, body: str):
    subprocess.run(["gh", "issue", "comment", str(issue), "--body", body], check=False)

def label_issue(issue: int, label: str):
    subprocess.run(["gh", "issue", "edit", str(issue), "--add-label", label], check=False)

def main():
    body = os.environ.get("ISSUE_BODY", "").strip()
    issue = int(os.environ.get("ISSUE_NUMBER", "0"))
    actor = os.environ.get("OWNER", "")

    if not body:
        comment_issue(issue, "⚠️ Body Issue kosong.")
        return

    first_line = body.splitlines()[0].strip()
    comment_issue(issue, f"⏳ Memproses: `{first_line}`")

    result = dispatch(text=first_line, channel="github_issue", user_id=actor)

    comment_issue(issue, f"```\n{result[:6000]}\n```")

    if result.startswith("⛔"):
        label_issue(issue, "rejected")
    else:
        label_issue(issue, "processed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os, time, hashlib
import requests
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from bots.core.dispatcher import dispatch

TOKEN = os.environ["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]
API = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}"
HMAC_SECRET = os.environ.get("HMAC_SECRET", "").encode()

def send(chat_id, text):
    requests.post(f"{API}/sendMessage",
                  json={"chat_id": chat_id, "text": text[:4000],
                        "parse_mode": "Markdown"})

def poll():
    offset = None
    while True:
        try:
            r = requests.get(f"{API}/getUpdates",
                             params={"timeout": 30, "offset": offset}).json()
            for u in r.get("result", []):
                offset = u["update_id"] + 1
                msg = u.get("message") or {}
                if not msg: continue
                chat_id = msg["chat"]["id"]
                user_id = msg["from"]["id"]
                text = (msg.get("text") or "").strip()
                if not text: continue

                # HMAC opsional: pesan bisa diawali "sig:<hex> ts:<unix> n:<nonce> | <command>"
                sig = ts = nonce = None
                payload = text
                if "|" in text and text.startswith("sig:"):
                    head, payload = text.split("|", 1)
                    kv = dict(p.split(":") for p in head.strip().split())
                    sig, ts, nonce = kv.get("sig"), int(kv.get("ts", 0)), kv.get("n")
                    payload = payload.strip()

                result = dispatch(text=payload, channel="telegram",
                                  user_id=str(user_id),
                                  signature=sig, ts=ts, nonce=nonce)
                send(chat_id, result)
        except Exception as e:
            print("poll error:", e)
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    poll()

"""
Load brain files sebagai konteks yang WAJIB disertakan ke setiap agent.
Cache dengan hash; reload jika file berubah atau owner kirim /reload brain.
"""
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List

BRAIN_DIR = Path("office/brain")
CACHE = Path("office/logs/brain_cache.json")
CACHE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

ORDER = [
    "vision.md", "strategy.md", "roadmap.md", "principles.md",
    "conventions.md", "stack.md", "security-rules.md",
    "onchain-rules.md", "glossary.md",
]

def _hash(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()

def load_brain(force: bool = False) -> Dict[str, str]:
    state = {}
    for name in ORDER:
        p = BRAIN_DIR / name
        if p.exists():
            text = p.read_text()
            state[name] = {"hash": _hash(text), "text": text}
        else:
            state[name] = {"hash": None, "text": ""}
    CACHE.write_text(json.dumps({k: v["hash"] for k, v in state.items()}, indent=2))
    return {k: v["text"] for k, v in state.items()}

def brain_prompt() -> str:
    b = load_brain()
    sections = []
    for name in ORDER:
        if b.get(name):
            sections.append(f"## {name}\n{b[name]}")
    return "\n\n".join(sections)

"""
Satu-satunya pintu approval. Tidak ada agent lain yang boleh bypass.
Approval disimpan sebagai file JSON per id, dengan status pending/approved/denied/expired.
"""
import json, time, uuid, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

STORE = Path("office/logs/approvals")
STORE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def _now(): return time.time()

def create(agent_id: str, gate: str, payload: dict, ttl_hours: int = 24) -> str:
    apv_id = f"apv_{int(_now())}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
    record = {
        "id": apv_id,
        "agent_id": agent_id,
        "gate": gate,
        "payload": payload,
        "status": "pending",
        "created": _now(),
        "expires": _now() + ttl_hours * 3600,
        "decided_by": None,
        "decided_at": None,
        "decision_note": None,
    }
    (STORE / f"{apv_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    return apv_id

def get(apv_id: str) -> dict | None:
    p = STORE / f"{apv_id}.json"
    if not p.exists(): return None
    return json.loads(p.read_text())

def decide(apv_id: str, decision: str, owner: str, note: str = "") -> dict:
    rec = get(apv_id)
    if not rec: return {"ok": False, "reason": "not_found"}
    if rec["status"] != "pending":
        return {"ok": False, "reason": f"already_{rec['status']}"}
    if _now() > rec["expires"]:
        rec["status"] = "expired"; (STORE / f"{apv_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(rec))
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "expired"}
    if decision not in ("approved", "denied"):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "invalid_decision"}
    rec["status"] = decision
    rec["decided_by"] = owner
    rec["decided_at"] = _now()
    rec["decision_note"] = note
    (STORE / f"{apv_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=2))
    return {"ok": True, "record": rec}

def list_pending() -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for p in STORE.glob("apv_*.json"):
        r = json.loads(p.read_text())
        if r["status"] == "pending":
            out.append(r)
    return sorted(out, key=lambda x: x["created"])

"""
Kill switch L0–L4. State disimpan di file agar tetap berlaku setelah restart.
"""
import json, time
from pathlib import Path

STATE = Path("office/logs/kill_switch.json")
STATE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

LEVELS = ["L0_PANIC", "L1_FREEZE_FINANCE", "L2_FREEZE_EXTERNAL",
          "L3_FREEZE_AGENT", "L4_READONLY"]

def _load() -> dict:
    if STATE.exists():
        return json.loads(STATE.read_text())
    return {"level": None, "scope": None, "since": None, "by": None}

def _save(s: dict):
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))

def current() -> dict:
    return _load()

def trigger(level: str, by: str, scope=None) -> dict:
    if level not in LEVELS:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "invalid_level"}
    s = {"level": level, "scope": scope, "since": time.time(), "by": by}
    _save(s)
    return {"ok": True, "state": s}

def restore(by: str) -> dict:
    s = {"level": None, "scope": None, "since": time.time(), "by": by}
    _save(s)
    return {"ok": True, "state": s}

def is_frozen(agent_id: str | None = None, category: str | None = None) -> bool:
    s = _load()
    if s["level"] is None: return False
    if s["level"] == "L0_PANIC": return True
    if s["level"] == "L4_READONLY": return True   # diblok tulis, dibaca orchestrator
    if s["level"] == "L3_FREEZE_AGENT":
        return agent_id is not None and s["scope"] == agent_id
    if s["level"] == "L1_FREEZE_FINANCE":
        return category in ("finance", "treasury", "onchain", "wallet")
    if s["level"] == "L2_FREEZE_EXTERNAL":
        return category in ("external", "social", "email", "webhook", "scanner")
    return False

"""
Evaluasi apakah aksi agent boleh langsung, notify, atau gate ke owner.
Sumber: agents.yaml + approval_matrix.yaml
"""
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

CFG = yaml.safe_load(Path("office/config/agents.yaml").read_text())
APV = yaml.safe_load(Path("office/config/approval_matrix.yaml").read_text())
AGENTS = {a["id"]: a for a in CFG["agents"]}
GATE_TTL = {g: d.get("timeout_hours", 24) for g, d in APV["gates"].items()}

def evaluate(agent: dict, action: dict) -> dict:
    """
    action: {"type": "...", "amount": ..., "is_public": bool, ...}
    Return: {"decision": "auto|notify|gate|deny", "gate": str|None, "reason": str}
    """
    cat = agent.get("cat", "")
    if agent.get("auto") == "gate":
        return {"decision": "gate",
                "gate": agent.get("gate", ["STR"])[0],
                "reason": "agent_requires_owner"}

    touched = set(agent.get("gate", []))
    if action.get("amount") and touched & {"FIN"}:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "FIN", "reason": "money_move"}
    if action.get("is_public") and "PUB" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "PUB", "reason": "public_action"}
    if action.get("is_deploy") and "DEP" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "DEP", "reason": "deploy_prod"}
    if action.get("is_onchain") and "CHAIN" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "CHAIN", "reason": "onchain_action"}
    if action.get("is_incident") and "INC" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "INC", "reason": "incident"}
    if action.get("is_legal") and "LEG" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "LEG", "reason": "legal_commit"}
    if action.get("is_people") and "PPL" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "PPL", "reason": "people_change"}
    if action.get("is_strategy") and "STR" in touched:
        return {"decision": "gate", "gate": "STR", "reason": "strategy_change"}

    if agent.get("auto") == "notify":
        return {"decision": "notify", "gate": None, "reason": "agent_notify_mode"}
    return {"decision": "auto", "gate": None, "reason": "ok"}

"""
Orchestrator utama. Menyatukan:
- brain loader
- kill switch
- policy engine
- approval broker
- notification (WA/Tele)
- audit log append-only
"""
import os, json, time, hashlib, yaml
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from .brain_loader import brain_prompt
from .kill_switch import current as kill_current, trigger as kill_trigger, restore as kill_restore, is_frozen
from .policy_engine import evaluate, AGENTS, GATE_TTL
from . import approval_broker as APV
from .audit import audit

# Notification gateway (fungsi dari notification_gateway.py)
try:
    from office.orchestrator.notification_gateway import send_owner
except Exception:
    def send_owner(_): pass

Channel = Literal["telegram", "whatsapp", "instagram", "threads", "github_issue"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _parse_command(text: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    parts = text.strip().split()
    if not parts: return "", []
    return parts[0].lower(), parts[1:]

def _status_report() -> str:
    s = kill_current()
    pending = APV.list_pending()
    lines = [
        f"🟢 Owner command center",
        f"Kill switch: {s['level'] or 'OFF'}",
        f"Pending approval: {len(pending)}",
    ]
    for p in pending[:10]:
        lines.append(f" • {p['id']} [{p['gate']}] agent={p['agent_id']}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def _execute(agent: dict, body: dict) -> dict:
    """
    Placeholder eksekusi. Di produksi: panggil adapter agent,
    beri konteks brain + SOP + tools.
    """
    return {"agent": agent["name"], "status": "executed",
            "echo": body.get("summary", "")[:200]}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def dispatch_command(text: str, channel: Channel, user_id: str) -> str:
    cmd, args = _parse_command(text)
    audit({"type": "cmd", "cmd": cmd, "channel": channel, "user": user_id})

    # Owner-only commands
    if cmd == "/status":         return _status_report()
    if cmd == "/agents":
        return "\n".join(f"{a['id']} {a['name']} ({a['cat']}/{a['auto']})"
                         for a in AGENTS.values())
    if cmd == "/cost today":
        return "Biaya: (hubungkan services/ai-gateway)"
    if cmd == "/panic":
        s = kill_trigger("L0_PANIC", by=user_id)
        return f"🛑 L0 PANIC aktif. {json.dumps(s['state'])}"
    if cmd == "/freeze" and args and args[0] == "finance":
        kill_trigger("L1_FREEZE_FINANCE", by=user_id); return "❄️ Finance frozen."
    if cmd == "/freeze" and args and args[0] == "external":
        kill_trigger("L2_FREEZE_EXTERNAL", by=user_id); return "❄️ External frozen."
    if cmd == "/freeze" and args and args[0] == "agent" and len(args) > 1:
        kill_trigger("L3_FREEZE_AGENT", by=user_id, scope=args[1])
        return f"❄️ Agent {args[1]} frozen."
    if cmd == "/readonly" and args and args[0] == "on":
        kill_trigger("L4_READONLY", by=user_id); return "📖 Read-only aktif."
    if cmd == "/readonly" and args and args[0] == "off":
        kill_restore(by=user_id); return "▶️ Restored."
    if cmd == "/recover":
        kill_restore(by=user_id); return "♻️ Restore ke state normal."
    if cmd == "/log" and args and args[0] == "last":
        n = int(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else 20
        return "\n".join(open("office/logs/audit.log").read().splitlines()[-n:])
    if cmd == "/approve" and args:
        r = APV.decide(args[0], "approved", owner=user_id)
        return f"✅ {args[0]}" if r["ok"] else f"❌ {r.get('reason')}"
    if cmd == "/deny" and args:
        r = APV.decide(args[0], "denied", owner=user_id,
                       note=" ".join(args[1:])[:200])
        return f"❌ {args[0]}" if r["ok"] else f"❌ {r.get('reason')}"
    if cmd == "/spawn" and len(args) >= 2 and args[0] == "agent":
        return f"🛠️ Spawn agent {args[1]} (hubungkan scripts/gen_agents.py)"
    if cmd == "/pr" and len(args) >= 1 and args[0] == "create":
        return "📝 PR create (hubungkan GitHub API)"

    return f"❓ Perintah tidak dikenal: {cmd}. Coba /status"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- agent action
def agent_act(agent_id: str, body: dict) -> dict:
    agent = AGENTS.get(agent_id)
    if not agent:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "unknown_agent"}

    if is_frozen(agent_id=agent_id, category=agent.get("cat")):
        audit({"type": "blocked_frozen", "agent": agent_id})
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "frozen"}

    verdict = evaluate(agent, body)
    audit({"type": "policy", "agent": agent_id, "verdict": verdict})

    if verdict["decision"] == "deny":
        return {"ok": False, "reason": verdict["reason"]}

    if verdict["decision"] == "gate":
        gate = verdict["gate"]
        apv_id = APV.create(agent_id, gate, body,
                            ttl_hours=GATE_TTL.get(gate, 24))
        send_owner(f"[GATE {gate}] {apv_id} • {agent['name']} • "
                   f"{body.get('summary','')[:160]}")
        return {"ok": True, "status": "pending_approval",
                "approval_id": apv_id}

    result = _execute(agent, body)
    if verdict["decision"] == "notify":
        send_owner(f"[{agent['name']}] ✅ {body.get('summary','')[:160]}")
    audit({"type": "executed", "agent": agent_id, "result": result})
    return {"ok": True, "result": result}

import json, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

AUDIT = Path("office/logs/audit.log")
AUDIT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def audit(event: dict):
    event = dict(event)
    event["ts"] = time.time()
    line = json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
    h = hashlib.sha256(line.encode()).hexdigest()
    with AUDIT.open("a") as f:
        f.write(f"{h} {line}\n")

import os, requests

TELE_TOKEN = os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN")
TELE_OWNER = os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID")
WA_TOKEN   = os.environ.get("WHATSAPP_TOKEN")
WA_OWNER   = os.environ.get("WHATSAPP_OWNER_NUMBER")

def send_owner(text: str):
    ok = False
    if TELE_TOKEN and TELE_OWNER:
        try:
            r = requests.post(
                f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TELE_TOKEN}/sendMessage",
                json={"chat_id": TELE_OWNER, "text": text[:4000]}, timeout=10)
            ok = r.ok
        except Exception: pass
    if not ok and WA_TOKEN and WA_OWNER:
        try:
            requests.post(
                "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/me/messages",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {WA_TOKEN}"},
                json={"messaging_product": "whatsapp",
                      "to": WA_OWNER,
                      "type": "text",
                      "text": {"body": text[:4000]}}, timeout=10)
        except Exception: pass
    return ok

import yaml
from pathlib import Path

def load_agents(path="office/config/agents.yaml") -> dict:
    raw = yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text())
    defaults = raw.get("defaults", {})
    merged = {}
    for a in raw["agents"]:
        full = {**defaults, **a}
        full["sop"] = full["sop"].format(id=a["id"])
        full["memory"] = full["memory"].format(id=a["id"])
        full["memory_namespace"] = full["memory_namespace"].format(id=a["id"])
        merged[a["id"]] = full
    return merged

if __name__ == "__main__":
    agents = load_agents()
    print(f"loaded {len(agents)} agents")
    print(agents["A001"]["objective"])

## Objective
{objective}

## Input
{input_list}

{output_list}

## Brain files WAJIB dibaca
- office/brain/vision.md
- office/brain/strategy.md

- office/brain/onchain-rules.md (jika menyentuh on-chain)

## Langkah kerja
1. Load brain + memory.
2. Baca task_spec dari orchestrator.
3. Cek gate: apakah aksi menyentuh FIN/LEG/PUB/INC/PPL/STR/DEP/CHAIN?
4. Jika ya → kirim ke ApprovalBroker, tunggu keputusan.
5. Jika tidak → eksekusi, tulis artifact, audit, handoff.
6. Tulis ringkasan ke memory/last_summary.md.

## Escalation
{escalation_rule}

## Gate owner
{approval_gate_list}

## KPI
{kpi_block}

## Handoff targets
{handoff_list}

## Tools
{tools_list}

# Memory — {name} ({id})

- `last_summary.md` — ringkasan kerja terakhir (≤ 500 kata).
- `context.json` — state terstruktur (task aktif, prioritas).
- `history/` — arsip per tanggal.

Aturan: memory hanya append. Rotasi > 30 hari → `history/`.

# Tools — {name} ({id})

Tool yang boleh dipakai agent ini. Akses sesuai `tools` di `agents.yaml`.
Default: llm, memory, audit. Tool tambahan wajib approval X002.

# {name} ({id})

Kategori: **{cat}** · Mode: **{auto}** · Gate: {gate_list}

Agent ini dibuat otomatis oleh `scripts/gen_agents.py`.
Edit `SOP.md` untuk mengubah perilaku tanpa mengubah kode orchestrator.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate office/agents/<id>/ untuk semua agent di agents.yaml.
Idempotent: tidak menimpa SOP.md yang sudah diedit (kecuali --force).
"""
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from office.orchestrator.config_loader import load_agents

ROOT = Path(".")
TEMPLATE = ROOT / "office/agents/_template"
AGENTS_DIR = ROOT / "office/agents"

FORCE = "--force" in sys.argv
DRY = "--dry" in sys.argv

def render_sop(a: dict) -> str:
    tpl = (TEMPLATE / "SOP.md").read_text()
    return (tpl
        .replace("{name}", a["name"])
        .replace("{id}", a["id"])
        .replace("{objective}", a.get("objective", ""))
        .replace("{input_list}", "\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in a.get("input", [])))
        .replace("{output_list}", "\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in a.get("output", [])))
        .replace("{escalation_rule}", a.get("escalation_rule", ""))
        .replace("{approval_gate_list}", ", ".join(a.get("approval_gate", []) or ["—"]))
        .replace("{kpi_block}", json.dumps(a.get("kpi", {}), indent=2))
        .replace("{handoff_list}", ", ".join(a.get("handoff_targets", [])))
        .replace("{tools_list}", ", ".join(a.get("tools", []))))

def render_readme(a: dict) -> str:
    tpl = (TEMPLATE / "README.md").read_text()
    return (tpl
        .replace("{name}", a["name"])
        .replace("{id}", a["id"])
        .replace("{cat}", a.get("cat", ""))
        .replace("{auto}", a.get("auto", ""))
        .replace("{gate_list}", ", ".join(a.get("gate", []) or ["—"])))

def write(path: Path, content: str):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if DRY:
        print(f"[DRY] {path}"); return
    path.write_text(content)

def main():
    agents = load_agents()
    print(f"generating {len(agents)} agents → {AGENTS_DIR}")
    for aid, a in agents.items():
        d = AGENTS_DIR / aid
        (d / "memory" / "history").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (d / "tools").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        readme = d / "README.md"
        if FORCE or not readme.exists():
            write(readme, render_readme(a))

        sop = d / "SOP.md"
        if FORCE or not sop.exists():
            write(sop, render_sop(a))

        mem_r = d / "memory" / "README.md"
        if FORCE or not mem_r.exists():
            write(mem_r, (TEMPLATE / "memory" / "README.md")
                  .read_text().replace("{name}", a["name"]).replace("{id}", aid))

        tools_r = d / "tools" / "README.md"
        if FORCE or not tools_r.exists():
            write(tools_r, (TEMPLATE / "tools" / "README.md")
                  .read_text().replace("{name}", a["name"]).replace("{id}", aid))

        summary = d / "memory" / "last_summary.md"
        if FORCE or not summary.exists():
            write(summary, f"# Last summary — {a['name']}\n\n(belum ada aktivitas)\n")

    print("selesai. Edit SOP per agent di office/agents/<id>/SOP.md")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal
from datetime import datetime

class PaymentIntent(BaseModel):
    id: str
    created_at: datetime
    agent_id: str
    amount: float = Field(gt=0)
    currency: Literal["IDR","USD","USDT","USDC"] = "IDR"
    recipient: str
    method: Literal["bank_transfer","ewallet","crypto","card","vendor_api"]
    purpose: str
    invoice_url: str | None = None
    risk_score: float = 0.0
    status: Literal["draft","pending_approval","approved","rejected","paid","failed"] = "draft"
    approval_id: str | None = None
    tx_hash: str | None = None

class ApprovalDecision(BaseModel):
    approval_id: str
    decision: Literal["approved","denied"]
    owner: str
    note: str = ""

"""
Skor risiko sederhana. Semua > 0.7 otomatis eskalasi ke owner (tidak auto-approve
meski agent mode notify).
"""
import re

HIGH_RISK_TLDS = {"xyz","top","click","buzz","loan"}
KNOWN_VENDORS = {"openai.com","anthropic.com","stripe.com","aws.amazon.com",
                 "cloudflare.com","github.com","vercel.com"}

def score(intent: dict) -> float:
    s = 0.0
    amt = intent.get("amount", 0)
    if amt > 10_000_000: s += 0.5
    elif amt > 1_000_000: s += 0.25
    elif amt > 100_000: s += 0.1

    recipient = (intent.get("recipient") or "").lower()
    if any(recipient.endswith("." + t) for t in HIGH_RISK_TLDS): s += 0.3
    if not re.match(r"^[\w.\-@:]+$", recipient): s += 0.2
    if "@" in recipient and not any(recipient.endswith(v) for v in KNOWN_VENDORS):
        s += 0.15

    if intent.get("method") == "crypto": s += 0.3
    if intent.get("method") == "card" and amt > 5_000_000: s += 0.2

    return min(s, 1.0)
"""
Gate FIN: semua pergerakan uang WAJIB lewat sini.
- Draft dibuat oleh agent AP/AR/Treasury.
- Risk score dihitung otomatis.
- Approval via ApprovalBroker (X002) → notif ke owner (WA/Tele).
- Eksekusi hanya setelah approved DAN kill switch L1 tidak aktif.
"""
import os, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from office.orchestrator import approval_broker as APV
from office.orchestrator.kill_switch import is_frozen
from office.orchestrator.audit import audit
from office.orchestrator.notification_gateway import send_owner
from services.payment.models import PaymentIntent, ApprovalDecision
from services.payment.risk import score

STORE = Path("services/payment/store")
STORE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def _save(intent: PaymentIntent):
    (STORE / f"{intent.id}.json").write_text(intent.model_dump_json(indent=2))

def _load(intent_id: str) -> PaymentIntent | None:
    p = STORE / f"{intent_id}.json"
    if not p.exists(): return None
    return PaymentIntent.model_validate_json(p.read_text())

def create_intent(agent_id: str, amount: float, recipient: str,
                  method: str, purpose: str, currency: str = "IDR",
                  invoice_url: str | None = None) -> dict:
    if is_frozen(category="finance"):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "L1_FREEZE_FINANCE_active"}

    intent_id = f"pay_{int(time.time())}_{agent_id.lower()}"
    risk = score({"amount": amount, "recipient": recipient, "method": method})

    intent = PaymentIntent(
        id=intent_id, created_at="", agent_id=agent_id,
        amount=amount, currency=currency, recipient=recipient,
        method=method, purpose=purpose, invoice_url=invoice_url,
        risk_score=risk,
    )
    # set created_at
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    intent.created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # bila risiko tinggi → tetap gate, tapi ttl lebih pendek
    ttl = 4 if risk > 0.7 else 24
    apv_id = APV.create(agent_id=agent_id, gate="FIN",
                        payload=intent.model_dump(), ttl_hours=ttl)

    intent.status = "pending_approval"
    intent.approval_id = apv_id
    _save(intent)

    risk_tag = "🔴 HIGH" if risk > 0.7 else ("🟡" if risk > 0.3 else "🟢")
    send_owner(
        f"[GATE FIN] {apv_id}\n"
        f"{risk_tag} risk={risk:.2f} • {agent_id}\n"
        f"{amount} {currency} → {recipient}\n"
        f"via {method} • {purpose[:80]}\n"
        f"Balas: /approve {apv_id} atau /deny {apv_id}"
    )
    audit({"type":"payment_intent","intent":intent.model_dump()})
    return {"ok": True, "intent_id": intent_id, "approval_id": apv_id,
            "risk_score": risk, "ttl_hours": ttl}

def execute(intent_id: str, actor: str) -> dict:
    """
    Eksekusi setelah approval FIN approved.
    Di produksi: panggil bank API / e-wallet / crypto signer (external, owner-only).
    """
    intent = _load(intent_id)
    if not intent:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "intent_not_found"}

    if is_frozen(category="finance"):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "frozen"}

    if not intent.approval_id:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "no_approval"}

    rec = APV.get(intent.approval_id)
    if not rec or rec["status"] != "approved":
        return {"ok": False, "reason": f"approval_{rec['status'] if rec else 'missing'}"}

    # Double-check: aktor harus owner
    if rec["decided_by"] != actor:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "actor_mismatch"}

    # Placeholder eksekusi — di produksi ini titik panggil API bank/e-wallet/on-chain
    # Wajib: idempotency key = intent_id
    result = {
        "provider": intent.method,
        "tx_ref": f"TX-{intent.id}",
        "status": "paid",
    }
    intent.status = "paid"
    intent.tx_hash = result["tx_ref"]
    _save(intent)

    audit({"type":"payment_paid","intent":intent.model_dump(),"result":result})
    send_owner(f"✅ PAID {intent.id} • {intent.amount} {intent.currency} → {intent.recipient}")
    return {"ok": True, "result": result}

def status(intent_id: str) -> dict:
    i = _load(intent_id)
    return i.model_dump() if i else {"ok": False, "reason": "not_found"}

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Header
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os
from services.payment import gate

app = FastAPI(title="Payment Service")
INTERNAL_KEY = os.environ.get("INTERNAL_KEY", "")

def _auth(x_internal_key: str):

class CreateReq(BaseModel):

# Payment Service

Semua uang keluar WAJIB lewat sini. Tidak ada jalur lain.

## Aturan keras
1. Agent tidak pernah sign transaksi / panggil bank API langsung.
2. Semua intent → gate FIN (ApprovalBroker X002).
3. Kill switch L1 aktif → semua intent ditolak.
4. Eksekusi hanya setelah owner approve + actor match.
5. Idempotency key = intent_id (tidak boleh dobel bayar).

## Alur
Agent → create_intent() → risk score → ApprovalBroker (X002) → notif owner
→ owner /approve → execute() → provider (bank/ewallet/crypto) → paid → audit.

## Env
- INTERNAL_KEY (wajib, hanya orchestrator & payment yang pegang)

"""
Sandbox policy enforcement. Setiap scanner WAJIB panggil ini sebelum akses jaringan.
Memblokir: write, credential access, wallet signing, tx send.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path

FORBIDDEN_ENV_VARS = [
    "PRIVATE_KEY","WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY","SEED_PHRASE","MNEMONIC",
    "BANK_API_SECRET","STRIPE_SECRET_KEY","OPENAI_API_KEY",
]

ALLOWED_HOSTS = {
    "airdrop": {"api.airdrops.io","defillama.com","dune.com","etherscan.io"},
    "bansos":  {"cek.dtsen.kemensos.go.id","kemensos.go.id","pkH.go.id"},
    "program": {"github.com","grants.gov","devpost.com","hackerone.com"},
    "nvidia":  {"nvidia.com","developer.nvidia.com","api.nvidia.com"},
}

class SandboxViolation(Exception): pass

def assert_clean_env():
    for var in FORBIDDEN_ENV_VARS:
        if os.environ.get(var):
            raise SandboxViolation(f"credential_leak: env {var} exposed to scanner")

def assert_host_allowed(scanner: str, host: str):
    allowed = ALLOWED_HOSTS.get(scanner, set())
    if host not in allowed:
        raise SandboxViolation(f"host_not_allowed: {host} for {scanner}")

def assert_read_only(method: str):
    if method.upper() in {"POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"}:
        raise SandboxViolation(f"write_method_blocked: {method}")

def enforce(scanner: str, host: str, method: str = "GET"):
    assert_clean_env()
    assert_host_allowed(scanner, host)
    assert_read_only(method)

import time
from collections import defaultdict

BUCKETS: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)

def allow(scanner: str, max_per_min: int = 10) -> bool:
    now = time.time()
    window = [t for t in BUCKETS[scanner] if now - t < 60]
    if len(window) >= max_per_min:
        return False
    window.append(now)
    BUCKETS[scanner] = window
    return True

"""
Radar airdrop — READ ONLY.
Output: intel report. BUKAN klaim otomatis.
"""
import httpx
from services.scanner import sandbox, ratelimit
from services.scanner.report import IntelReport, write_report

async def scan(keywords: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    if not ratelimit.allow("airdrop", max_per_min=10):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "rate_limited"}

    host = "api.airdrops.io"
    sandbox.enforce("airdrop", host, "GET")

    findings = []
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as c:
        try:
            r = await c.get(f"https://{host}/v1/airdrops",
                            params={"status": "active"})
            for item in (r.json().get("data") or [])[:20]:
                findings.append({
                    "name": item.get("name"),
                    "chain": item.get("chain"),
                    "risk_flags": item.get("risk_flags", []),
                    "source": host,
                })
        except Exception as e:
            return {"ok": False, "reason": f"fetch_error: {e}"}

    report = IntelReport(
        scanner="airdrop",
        findings=findings,
        escalate_to=["S008_ThreatIntelAnalyst","S010_FraudDetectionEngineer"],
    )
    path = write_report(report)
    return {"ok": True, "report": str(path), "count": len(findings)}

"""
NVIDIA Spectrum scan — READ ONLY.
Output: security report + evidence hash (sha256) untuk audit.
Tidak boleh: kirim payload, jalankan binary lokal, tanda tangan apa pun.
"""
import hashlib, json, httpx
from services.scanner import sandbox, ratelimit
from services.scanner.report import IntelReport, write_report

async def scan(target: str) -> dict:
    if not ratelimit.allow("nvidia", max_per_min=5):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "rate_limited"}

    host = "api.nvidia.com"
    sandbox.enforce("nvidia", host, "GET")

    evidence = {"target": target, "scanner": "nvidia_spectrum"}
    findings = []
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as c:
            r = await c.get(f"https://{host}/v1/spectrum/scan",
                            params={"target": target})
            data = r.json()
            findings = data.get("vulnerabilities", [])
            evidence["response_digest"] = hashlib.sha256(
                json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode()
            ).hexdigest()
    except Exception as e:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": f"scan_error: {e}"}

    report = IntelReport(
        scanner="nvidia_spectrum",
        findings=findings,
        evidence=evidence,
        escalate_to=["S008_ThreatIntelAnalyst","S016_IncidentResponseEngineer"],
    )
    return {"ok": True, "report": str(write_report(report)),
            "count": len(findings), "evidence_hash": evidence["response_digest"]}

import json, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import List

OUT = Path("services/scanner/reports")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

@dataclass
class IntelReport:
    scanner: str
    findings: List[dict]
    escalate_to: List[str]
    evidence: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    ts: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

def write_report(report: IntelReport) -> Path:
    payload = asdict(report)
    payload["hash"] = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode()
    ).hexdigest()
    p = OUT / f"{report.scanner}_{int(report.ts)}.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
    return p

# Scanner Service (READ-ONLY)

## Aturan keras (dijaga `sandbox.py`)
1. Hanya HTTP GET. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE ditolak.
2. Host wajib ada di allowlist per scanner.
3. Env kredensial (`PRIVATE_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, dll) TIDAK BOLEH terbaca.
4. Rate limit: airdrop 10/min, bansos 5/min, program 5/min, nvidia 5/min.
5. Output → `IntelReport` + hash → audit. Bukan eksekusi.
6. Wallet signing / claim airdrop / auto-apply TIDAK ADA di service ini.
   Kalau butuh → gate CHAIN lewat payment/on-chain service, dan hanya owner.

## Endpoint
- GET /scan/airdrop
- GET /scan/bansos?region=...
- GET /scan/program?q=...
- GET /scan/nvidia?target=...

## Env
- INTERNAL_KEY (wajib, hanya orchestrator yang pegang)
- NVIDIA_SPECTRUM_API_KEY (opsional, dikirim via header oleh scanner internal)

x-common: &common
  restart: unless-stopped
  env_file: [../../.env]
  networks: [internal]

x-secure: &secure
  <<: *common
  read_only: true
  tmpfs: [/tmp]
  cap_drop: [ALL]
  security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]

services:
  orchestrator:
    <<: *secure
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.orchestrator
    ports: ["8000:8000"]
    volumes:
      - ../../office/logs:/app/office/logs
      - ../../office/brain:/app/office/brain:ro
      - ../../office/config:/app/office/config:ro
    depends_on: [redis, postgres]

  payment:
    <<: *secure
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.payment
    ports: ["8001:8001"]
    volumes:
      - ../../services/payment/store:/app/services/payment/store
      - ../../office/logs:/app/office/logs
    depends_on: [orchestrator]

  scanner:
    <<: *secure
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.scanner
    ports: ["8002:8002"]
    # Sandbox: tanpa host network, tanpa akses .env sensitif (gunakan .env.scanner)

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks: [internal]

    internal: true

volumes:
  pg_data:

## 1. Bot Defense
- Enable "Bot Fight Mode" (free) atau "Super Bot Fight Mode" (Pro).
- Challenge: semua `POST` ke `/api/*`, `/payment/*`, `/scan/*`.
- Block: user-agent kosong + request ke endpoint sensitif.

## 2. Rate Limit
| Path | Limit | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/login` | 5/min/IP | block 15 menit |
| `/api/*` | 60/min/IP | challenge |
| `/payment/*` | 10/min/IP | block |
| `/scan/*` | 20/min/IP | block |
| `/agent/*/act` | 30/min/IP | block + alert |

## 3. Geo & ASN
- Block: TOR exit, ASN hosting publik (opsional).
- Owner bypass: header `CF-Connecting-IP` di-whitelist untuk IP owner.

## 4. Managed Rules
- OWASP Core Ruleset: ON.
- Cloudflare Managed: ON.
- Anomaly score: block > 50, challenge > 20.

## 5. Origin Protection
- Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) — origin TIDAK terbuka ke internet.
- mTLS antara CF dan origin.
- Header wajib di origin: `CF-Access-Jwt-Assertion` valid.

## 6. Kill switch integration
- Cloudflare Worker subscribe ke KV "kill_switch" → bila L0/L2 aktif,
  worker return 503 untuk semua request non-owner.

// Cloudflare Worker: cek KV kill_switch, block bila aktif.
export default {
  async fetch(req, env) {
    const state = await env.KILL_SWITCH.get("state"); // "OFF" | "L0" | "L1" | ...
    if (state && state !== "OFF" && state !== "null") {
      const isOwner = req.headers.get("X-Owner-Token") === env.OWNER_TOKEN;
      if (!isOwner) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({
          ok: false, reason: `kill_switch:${state}`
        }), { status: 503, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }});
      }
    }
    return fetch(req);
  }
}

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.6"
  required_providers {
    cloudflare = { source = "cloudflare/cloudflare", version = "~> 4.0" }
  }
}

provider "cloudflare" {
  api_token = var.cloudflare_api_token
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "app" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = var.domain
  value   = var.tunnel_cname
  type    = "CNAME"
  proxied = true
}

resource "cloudflare_ruleset" "waf_custom" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = "custom-waf"
  kind    = "zone"
  phase   = "http_request_firewall_custom"

  rules {
    action      = "block"
    expression  = "(http.request.uri.path contains \"/payment\" and http.request.method eq \"POST\" and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot)"
    description = "block unverified bot on payment"
  }

  rules {
    action      = "challenge"
    expression  = "(http.request.uri.path contains \"/scan\")"
    description = "challenge scanner endpoints"
  }

  rules {
    action      = "block"
    expression  = "(ip.geoip.country in {\"T1\"})"   # TOR
    description = "block TOR"
  }
}

resource "cloudflare_ruleset" "ratelimit" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = "ratelimit"
  kind    = "zone"
  phase   = "http_ratelimit"

  rules {
    action      = "block"
    expression  = "(http.request.uri.path contains \"/payment\")"
    description = "payment 10/min"
    ratelimit {
      characteristics     = ["ip.src"]
      period              = 60
      requests_per_period = 10
      mitigation_timeout  = 900
    }
  }

  rules {
    action      = "block"
    expression  = "(http.request.uri.path contains \"/scan\")"
    description = "scan 20/min"
    ratelimit {
      characteristics     = ["ip.src"]
      period              = 60
      requests_per_period = 20
      mitigation_timeout  = 600
    }
  }
}

resource "cloudflare_tunnel" "origin" {
  account_id = var.account_id
  name       = "office-origin"
  secret     = var.tunnel_secret
}

variable "cloudflare_api_token" { type = string, sensitive = true }
variable "account_id"           { type = string }
variable "zone_id"              { type = string }
variable "domain"               { type = string, default = "app" }
variable "tunnel_cname"         { type = string }
variable "tunnel_secret"        { type = string, sensitive = true }

2. Semua container: non-root, `read_only`, `cap_drop: ALL`, `no-new-privileges`.
3. Scanner punya network sendiri (`scanner_net`), tidak bisa akses `internal`.
4. `.env.scanner` TIDAK berisi `PRIVATE_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, dll.
5. Semua log ditulis ke `office/logs/` (append-only, mount RW khusus).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Health check semua service. Dipakai keepalive.yml."""
import os, sys, httpx

URLS = {
    "orchestrator": os.environ.get("HEALTH_ORCH",  "http://localhost:8000/health"),
    "payment":      os.environ.get("HEALTH_PAY",   "http://localhost:8001/health"),
    "scanner":      os.environ.get("HEALTH_SCAN",  "http://localhost:8002/health"),
}

fails = []
for name, url in URLS.items():
    try:
        r = httpx.get(url, timeout=5)
        if r.status_code != 200: fails.append(f"{name}:{r.status_code}")
    except Exception as e:
        fails.append(f"{name}:{type(e).__name__}")

if fails:
    print("FAIL " + ",".join(fails)); sys.exit(1)
print("OK")

"""
Adapter provider LLM. Semua provider punya interface sama:
  async def complete(model, messages, **kwargs) -> dict
  async def stream(model, messages, **kwargs) -> AsyncIterator[dict]
"""
import os, httpx
from typing import AsyncIterator

class ProviderBase:
    name: str = "base"
    base_url: str = ""
    api_key_env: str = ""

    def __init__(self):
        self.api_key = os.environ.get(self.api_key_env, "")

    def available(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.api_key)

    async def complete(self, model: str, messages: list, **kw) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def stream(self, model: str, messages: list, **kw) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class OpenAIProvider(ProviderBase):
    name = "openai"; base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"; api_key_env = "OPENAI_API_KEY"

    async def complete(self, model, messages, **kw) -> dict:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=90) as c:
            r = await c.post(f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
                json={"model": model, "messages": messages, **kw})
            r.raise_for_status()
            d = r.json()
            return {"provider": self.name, "model": model,
                    "content": d["choices"][0]["message"]["content"],
                    "usage": d.get("usage", {})}


class AnthropicProvider(ProviderBase):
    name = "anthropic"; base_url = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1"; api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"

    async def complete(self, model, messages, **kw) -> dict:
        sys = next((m["content"] for m in messages if m["role"] == "system"), None)
        msgs = [m for m in messages if m["role"] != "system"]
        body = {"model": model, "max_tokens": kw.get("max_tokens", 2048), "messages": msgs}
        if sys: body["system"] = sys
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=90) as c:
            r = await c.post(f"{self.base_url}/messages",
                headers={"x-api-key": self.api_key, "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01"},
                json=body)
            r.raise_for_status()
            d = r.json()
            return {"provider": self.name, "model": model,
                    "content": d["content"][0]["text"],
                    "usage": d.get("usage", {})}


class LocalProvider(ProviderBase):
    """Fallback lokal: Ollama di localhost."""
    name = "local"; base_url = "http://localhost:11434"; api_key_env = "LOCAL_LLM_KEY"

    def available(self) -> bool: return True   # selalu ada

    async def complete(self, model, messages, **kw) -> dict:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120) as c:
            r = await c.post(f"{self.base_url}/api/chat",
                json={"model": model, "messages": messages, "stream": False})
            r.raise_for_status()
            d = r.json()
            return {"provider": self.name, "model": model,
                    "content": d["message"]["content"],
                    "usage": d.get("eval_count", {})}


PROVIDERS = {
    "openai": OpenAIProvider(),
    "anthropic": AnthropicProvider(),
    "local": LocalProvider(),
}
"""
Budget enforcement. Kalau lewat batas, tolak (bukan "warning").
Budget harian per kategori agent + global.
"""
import time, json
from pathlib import Path

STORE = Path("services/ai-gateway/usage")
STORE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Harga per 1K token (USD) — perkiraan, sesuaikan
PRICES = {
    "openai:gpt-4o":            {"in": 0.005, "out": 0.015},
    "openai:gpt-4o-mini":       {"in": 0.00015, "out": 0.0006},
    "anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet": {"in": 0.003, "out": 0.015},
    "local:*":                  {"in": 0.0, "out": 0.0},
}

# Budget USD per hari
DAILY_BUDGET = {
    "global":         float(200),
    "exec":           float(50),
    "eng":            float(60),
    "ai":             float(60),
    "sec":            float(20),
    "mkt":            float(10),
    "fin":            float(5),
}

def _path(cat: str) -> Path:
    day = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    return STORE / f"{cat}_{day}.json"

def _load(cat: str) -> dict:
    p = _path(cat)
    return json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {"spent": 0.0, "calls": 0}

def _save(cat: str, data: dict):
    _path(cat).write_text(json.dumps(data))

def price(provider: str, model: str, in_tok: int, out_tok: int) -> float:
    key = f"{provider}:{model}"
    tier = PRICES.get(key) or PRICES.get(f"{provider}:*") or {"in": 0.001, "out": 0.002}
    return (in_tok/1000)*tier["in"] + (out_tok/1000)*tier["out"]

def check(cat: str, est_usd: float) -> dict:
    cat_budget = DAILY_BUDGET.get(cat, 10.0)
    glob_budget = DAILY_BUDGET["global"]
    cat_spent = _load(cat)["spent"]
    glob_spent = _load("global")["spent"]
    if cat_spent + est_usd > cat_budget:
        return {"allow": False, "reason": f"cat_budget_exceeded({cat})"}
    if glob_spent + est_usd > glob_budget:
        return {"allow": False, "reason": "global_budget_exceeded"}
    return {"allow": True}

def record(cat: str, usd: float):
    c = _load(cat); c["spent"] += usd; c["calls"] += 1; _save(cat, c)
    g = _load("global"); g["spent"] += usd; g["calls"] += 1; _save("global", g)

def report() -> dict:
    day = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    out = {}
    for cat in DAILY_BUDGET:
        d = _load(cat)
        out[cat] = {"spent": round(d["spent"], 4),
                    "budget": DAILY_BUDGET[cat],
                    "calls": d["calls"]}
    return {"day": day, "budget": out}

"""
Router LLM dengan fallback berjenjang:
  primary (per kategori) → fallback_1 → fallback_2 → local
Cost guard dicek SEBELUM panggil. Audit setiap panggilan.
"""
import sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from services.ai_gateway import cost_guard, providers
from office.orchestrator.audit import audit

# Routing default per kategori agent
DEFAULT_ROUTE = {
    "exec":  [("anthropic","claude-3-5-sonnet"), ("openai","gpt-4o"), ("local","llama3")],
    "eng":   [("openai","gpt-4o"), ("anthropic","claude-3-5-sonnet"), ("local","llama3")],
    "ai":    [("openai","gpt-4o-mini"), ("anthropic","claude-3-5-sonnet"), ("local","llama3")],
    "sec":   [("anthropic","claude-3-5-sonnet"), ("openai","gpt-4o"), ("local","llama3")],
    "mkt":   [("openai","gpt-4o-mini"), ("local","llama3")],
    "fin":   [("anthropic","claude-3-5-sonnet"), ("openai","gpt-4o-mini")],
    "default":[("openai","gpt-4o-mini"), ("local","llama3")],
}

# Estimasi token kasar sebelum panggil (guard biaya)
def _est_tokens(messages: list) -> int:
    return sum(len(m.get("content",""))//4 + 10 for m in messages)

async def complete(cat: str, messages: list, agent_id: str, **kw) -> dict:
    route = DEFAULT_ROUTE.get(cat, DEFAULT_ROUTE["default"])
    est_in = _est_tokens(messages)
    est_out = kw.get("max_tokens", 2048)
    last_err = None

    for provider_name, model in route:
        prov = providers.PROVIDERS.get(provider_name)
        if not prov or not prov.available():
            continue

        est_usd = cost_guard.price(provider_name, model, est_in, est_out)
        guard = cost_guard.check(cat, est_usd)
        if not guard["allow"]:
            audit({"type":"llm_blocked","agent":agent_id,"cat":cat,"reason":guard["reason"]})
            # coba provider berikutnya (mungkin lebih murah)
            continue

        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            out = await prov.complete(model, messages, **kw)
            usage = out.get("usage") or {}
            in_tok = usage.get("prompt_tokens") or usage.get("input_tokens") or est_in
            out_tok = usage.get("completion_tokens") or usage.get("output_tokens") or est_out
            usd = cost_guard.price(provider_name, model, in_tok, out_tok)
            cost_guard.record(cat, usd)

            audit({"type":"llm_call","agent":agent_id,"provider":provider_name,
                   "model":model,"in":in_tok,"out":out_tok,
                   "usd":round(usd,6),"ms":int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
            return {**out, "cost_usd": usd, "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)}
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{provider_name}:{type(e).__name__}:{e}"
            audit({"type":"llm_error","agent":agent_id,"err":last_err})
            continue

    audit({"type":"llm_all_failed","agent":agent_id,"err":str(last_err)})
    raise RuntimeError(f"all providers failed: {last_err}")

# AI Gateway

Satu pintu untuk semua panggilan LLM. Tidak ada agent yang boleh panggil
provider langsung.

## Aturan
1. Semua panggilan lewat `/chat` dengan `INTERNAL_KEY`.
2. Cost guard dicek sebelum panggil. Kalau budget habis → tolak.
3. Fallback berjenjang: primary → fallback → local.
4. Setiap panggilan diaudit (agent, provider, model, token, USD, latency).

## Budget harian (ubah di cost_guard.py)
| Kategori | Budget USD/hari |
|---|---|
| global | 200 |
| exec   | 50 |
| eng    | 60 |
| ai     | 60 |
| sec    | 20 |
| mkt    | 10 |
| fin    | 5 |

## Env
- OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
- INTERNAL_KEY (wajib)
- LOCAL_LLM_KEY (opsional)

## Command owner
- `/cost today` → tampilkan pemakaian hari ini (via orchestrator)

"""
Verifikasi hash chain di office/logs/audit.log.
Format baris: <sha256(line)> <json_line>
Kalau ada manipulasi, chain putus dan terdeteksi.
"""
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

AUDIT = Path("office/logs/audit.log")

def verify_chain(path: Path = AUDIT) -> dict:
    if not path.exists():
        return {"ok": True, "reason": "empty"}
    bad = []
    total = 0
    with path.open() as f:
        for i, raw in enumerate(f, 1):
            raw = raw.rstrip("\n")
            if not raw.strip(): continue
            total += 1
            try:
                h, payload = raw.split(" ", 1)
            except ValueError:
                bad.append({"line": i, "reason": "malformed"}); continue
            computed = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()
            if computed != h:
                bad.append({"line": i, "reason": "hash_mismatch",
                            "expected": computed, "found": h})
            # pastikan json valid
            try: json.loads(payload)
            except Exception: bad.append({"line": i, "reason": "invalid_json"})
    return {"ok": len(bad) == 0, "total": total, "bad": bad[:20],
            "bad_count": len(bad)}

"""
Rekonstruksi insiden dari audit log.
Query: rentang waktu, agent_id, channel, atau tipe event.
Output: timeline yang bisa dibaca manusia.
"""
import json, time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

AUDIT = Path("office/logs/audit.log")

def _iter_events():
    if not AUDIT.exists(): return
    with AUDIT.open() as f:
        for raw in f:
            raw = raw.strip()
            if not raw: continue
            try:
                _, payload = raw.split(" ", 1)
                yield json.loads(payload)
            except Exception:
                continue

def timeline(start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
             agent: str | None = None, event_type: str | None = None,
             channel: str | None = None, limit: int = 500) -> list[dict]:
    start = start or 0.0
    end = end or time.time()
    out = []
    for e in _iter_events():
        ts = e.get("ts", 0)
        if not (start <= ts <= end): continue
        if agent and e.get("agent") != agent: continue
        if event_type and e.get("type") != event_type: continue
        if channel and e.get("channel") != channel: continue
        e["_human_ts"] = datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts).isoformat()+"Z"
        out.append(e)
        if len(out) >= limit: break
    return out

def incident_summary(incident_id: str) -> dict:
    """
    Ambil semua event yang terkait insiden berdasarkan approval_id atau intent_id.
    """
    keys = set()
    events = []
    for e in _iter_events():
        blob = json.dumps(e)
        if incident_id in blob:
            events.append(e)
            if e.get("approval_id"): keys.add(e["approval_id"])
    # lengkapi dengan event terkait approval_ids
    for e in _iter_events():
        if e.get("id") in keys or e.get("approval_id") in keys:
            if e not in events: events.append(e)
    events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("ts", 0))
    return {"incident_id": incident_id, "events": events,
            "count": len(events)}

import os
from services.audit import verifier, forensics

app = FastAPI(title="Audit Service")
INTERNAL_KEY = os.environ.get("INTERNAL_KEY","")

def _auth(k: str):
    if not INTERNAL_KEY or k != INTERNAL_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(401, "unauthorized")

@app.get("/health")
def health(): return {"ok": True}

@app.get("/verify")
def verify(x_internal_key: str = Header(default="")):
    _auth(x_internal_key)
    return verifier.verify_chain()

@app.get("/timeline")
def timeline(start: float = 0, end: float = 0, agent: str = "",
             event_type: str = "", channel: str = "", limit: int = 200,
             x_internal_key: str = Header(default="")):
    _auth(x_internal_key)
    return {"events": forensics.timeline(
        start=start or None, end=end or None,
        agent=agent or None, event_type=event_type or None,
        channel=channel or None, limit=limit)}

@app.get("/incident/{incident_id}")
def incident(incident_id: str, x_internal_key: str = Header(default="")):
    _auth(x_internal_key)
    return forensics.incident_summary(incident_id)
# Audit Service

Append-only log verifier + forensics.

## Endpoint
- `GET /verify` — cek hash chain, return `{ok, total, bad_count, bad[:20]}`
- `GET /timeline?start=&end=&agent=&event_type=&channel=&limit=`
- `GET /incident/{approval_id|intent_id}` — rekonstruksi insiden

## Jadwal
- `nightly-audit.yml` panggil `/verify` setiap malam.
- Kalau `ok=false` → alert critical ke owner + otomatis L4_READONLY.

## Aturan
- Log TIDAK BOLEH dihapus/diedit agent.
- Rotasi hanya oleh owner (arsip ke cold storage, hash tetap disimpan).

"""
Dijalankan oleh .github/workflows/nightly-audit.yml.
Jika chain rusak → trigger L4_READONLY otomatis + alert owner.
"""
import sys, httpx
from services.audit.verifier import verify_chain
from office.orchestrator.kill_switch import trigger
from office.orchestrator.notification_gateway import send_owner

def main():
    r = verify_chain()
    if r["ok"]:
        send_owner(f"🌙 Nightly audit OK. {r['total']} event.")
        return 0
    trigger("L4_READONLY", by="nightly_audit")
    send_owner(f"🚨 AUDIT CHAIN RUSAK! bad={r['bad_count']}\n"
               f"L4_READONLY aktif otomatis. Cek /verify.")
    return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
Helper HMAC untuk adapter yang butuh signature
(WA Cloud API, Meta Graph, Telegram formatter).
"""
import hmac, hashlib, time, os, secrets

SECRET = os.environ.get("HMAC_SECRET","").encode()

def sign(payload: str, ts: int | None = None,
         nonce: str | None = None) -> dict:
    ts = ts or int(time.time())
    nonce = nonce or secrets.token_hex(8)
    msg = f"{payload}|{ts}|{nonce}".encode()
    sig = hmac.new(SECRET, msg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return {"sig": sig, "ts": ts, "nonce": nonce}

def format_signed(command: str) -> str:
    """Format pesan kirim dari owner (opsional, untuk perintah sensitif)."""
    s = sign(command)
    return f"sig:{s['sig']} ts:{s['ts']} n:{s['nonce']} | {command}"

"""
Instagram DM adapter via Meta Graph API (Instagram Messaging).
Webhook: /webhook/instagram
Owner ID: INSTAGRAM_OWNER_ID (IGSID)
"""
import os, hmac, hashlib, json, httpx, sys
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from bots.core.dispatcher import dispatch

app = FastAPI(title="Instagram Bot")
TOKEN = os.environ.get("INSTAGRAM_TOKEN","")
PAGE_ID = os.environ.get("INSTAGRAM_PAGE_ID","")
APP_SECRET = os.environ.get("INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET","").encode()

def _verify_sig(body: bytes, sig: str) -> bool:
    if not APP_SECRET: return True
    expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(APP_SECRET, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig)

def _send(recipient: str, text: str):
    if not TOKEN or not PAGE_ID: return
    httpx.post(
        f"https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{PAGE_ID}/messages",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"},
        json={"recipient": {"id": recipient},
              "message": {"text": text[:1000]}},   # IG limit 1000 char
        timeout=15,
    )

@app.post("/webhook/instagram")
async def webhook(req: Request):
    raw = await req.body()
    if not _verify_sig(raw, req.headers.get("x-hub-signature-256","")):
        raise HTTPException(403, "bad_signature")
    data = json.loads(raw)
    for entry in data.get("entry", []):
        for m in (entry.get("messaging") or []):
            sender = str(m.get("sender",{}).get("id",""))
            text = (m.get("message",{}).get("text") or "").strip()
            if not text or not sender: continue
            result = dispatch(text=text, channel="instagram", user_id=sender)
            _send(sender, result)
    return {"ok": True}
